messages:
Lina (CSM): Heads up: NimbusEdge EBR booked Thu 11am PT. Need final slide set + one-page runbook by Wed EOD. Quick list below.

Lina (CSM): Ask list:
- Health metrics (funnel, active integrations, error rate)
- Onboarding progress + remaining milestones
- Contract/renewal posture + risk mitigation options
- Enablement plan (recordings, playbook links, customer enablement owners)
- Open feedback and owners (billing, UX, API docs)

Omar (CS Ops): I'll build the health slide. Planning to include weekly integration installs, 7d active hosts, and 30/60/90 retention. Which retention window do we prefer? :thinking_face:

Camila (AE): For renewal posture, account currently net-new (on Year 1) but pilot-to-paid conversion stalled. Renewal is early but exec wants usage proof. I'll draft a pilot-to-contract timeline + incentive (3mo usage credit).

Lina (CSM): Good. Add a short internals note about who on their side is approving contracts (they mentioned "Legal: Marco Silva").

Ravi (Enablement): I'll produce a 10-min enablement clip focusing on admin onboarding and integration checklist. Will host an office hours Wed 4pm PT. Recording will be on the enablement drive.

Devon (SE): For errors, quick snippet from monitoring to include on the health slide:
```text
Last 30d error rate: 0.9%\nTop error: auth token mismatch (12 incidents)\nMedian latency: 210ms\n```
I'll export a 1-slide PNG.

Omar (CS Ops): Retention window: let's show 7/30/90 and a small sparkline for trend. I'll include MAU and active integrations.

Lina (CSM): Action items (please reply with DONE when complete):
```
- Omar: Health slide with 7/30/90 retention + sparkline (due Wed EOD)
- Devon: Export perf/error PNG and paste in drive (due Wed noon)
- Ravi: Enablement clip + office hours invite and link (due Wed EOD)
- Camila: Renewal posture slide + suggested incentive + exec ask (due Wed EOD)
- Lina: One-pager runbook and speaking notes (due Wed EOD)
```

Camila (AE): Quick question: can we surface the integration success story (ACME pilot) as a 1-slide case study? That might help sponsor confidence.

Lina (CSM): Yes, include a short "pilot win" slide: before/after metrics and quote from ACME PM. Devon can pull the quote if available.

Devon (SE): I have the ACME quote in the support thread. Will grab and anonymize if needed.

calendar-bot: Reminder created: upload final deck 24h before meeting. Invite includes execs and primary sponsor.

Omar (CS Ops): Capturing feedback owners: billing -> Camila, API docs -> Ravi, admin UX -> Lina. Will add to the feedback slide.

Lina (CSM): Perfect. Aim to lower perceived risk by showing pilot lift + proactive enablement. Ping if blockers. :raised_hands:
